about: Every place the Cuphead plugin touches Cuphead's code (Harmony patches on Cuphead's Assembly-CSharp). target must exist in the decompiled game; symbol must exist in src/CupheadMod.

columns.target: Class.Method patched: Cuphead by default, 'ROUNDS ' prefix for the card engine's patches, '(runtime patch)' when found by reflection
columns.symbol: patch method in src/CupheadMod or src/CardEngine
columns.effects: effects.id served, comma separated, or none

rows.does: attach the ROUNDS blob (body, gun, block, health) to each ground-level player
set move speed and jump power from the build
ROUNDS jumps (ground, extra air jumps, wall jumps) replace Cuphead's; dropping through platforms stays Cuphead's
ROUNDS gravity and air drag while airborne (Cuphead's own knockbacks, parry bounces and pit knock-ups are kept)
parry starts from block instead of a second jump press
no Cuphead dash; the dash button blocks
Cuphead weapons, EX and supers stay silent; the ROUNDS gun fires instead
no weapon switching
hearts from ROUNDS max health
a hit during the block window is blocked
respawn cards save the blob
a won level ends the match: both decks are wiped (progression level_won; a Dice Palace mini boss keeps them)
a lost level: each player gets a loss pick on the game-over card (progression loss)
the game-over card's menu (Retry, Exit to Map, Quit) waits while the loss picks are made on it; without ROUNDS it goes on after 15 s and the picks wait for the map
refresh the stand-in builds from the decks (a pick left over from a quit game-over card is offered here by PickOverlay)
erasing a Cuphead save slot erases its ROUNDS decks too
add Porkrind's card pack to the shop
Melty test runs never write the player's Cuphead save
each player walks the world map as their ROUNDS blob
ROUNDS run momentum replaces Cuphead's instant walk speed
while ROUNDS's real player stands in (arena live), Cuphead's motor stays still and the player object follows ROUNDS
a Cuphead co-op revive brings ROUNDS's player back at full health where the ghost was parried (resent until ROUNDS confirms)

a ROUNDS-driven player's death: Cuphead's ghost sprite and explosion puffs stay off (ROUNDS plays its own death burst) and a ROUNDS-style ghost (RoundsGhost, in a parry-pink ring) floats in their place around Cuphead's parry heart, so co-op revives still work (PlayerSprites.DressGhost; a ghost from before the blob is dressed when the blob attaches); plane levels keep Cuphead's
the same for a ghost that never ran Init (a scene-placed TutorialPlayerDeathEffect)
with the Astral Cookie (or Chalice carried over) the separate Cuphead/Mugman body Cuphead stands at the spawn through the intro stays off
leaving the tutorial house: the Cuphead/Mugman running out of the door stays off

a ROUNDS-driven player's drop shadow is cast from the ROUNDS body, so it sits at its feet (Cuphead's cast from its own, lower, player object began inside the floor and drew a body too low) and shows while standing too
the game-over card's boss timeline marks each player with a dot in their ROUNDS colour instead of a Cuphead/Mugman head
the character-shaped death explosion and its shadow stay off (a leaving player's too): ROUNDS's burst is the death
the Cuphead/Mugman jump-in of a mid-level join stays off; ROUNDS's revive pop-in shows the player arriving
player 1's WASD and Space work on the world map and in menus without changing Cuphead's saved bindings
ROUNDS's players read the Cuphead player's input from the arena link
Cuphead's camera and pits decide the edges, not ROUNDS's fixed arena box
Cuphead decides when a fallen player comes back (co-op revive, retry)
record which card the player took on ROUNDS's pick screen
ROUNDS's pick screen follows the Cuphead player's keys, stick or mouse
the hidden ROUNDS ignores the gamepad's Start: its escape menu would freeze ROUNDS and its buttons could quit or reload it mid-level
ROUNDS's QUIT GAME does nothing in the hidden engine (only Cuphead closing ends it)
no extra ROUNDS players join from a gamepad or key press; only the arena makes players
ROUNDS's time stands still while Cuphead is paused or away (ROUNDS's own pause: time scale 0)
co-op: a partner's ROUNDS bullet passes through you (own bounced bullets still hit, as in ROUNDS)
co-op: no damage from a partner of any kind (explosions, card effects)
Poison and Parasite on a Cuphead enemy: ROUNDS's DoT tick maths run on the CupheadTarget, each tick a HitDot with the poison colour and lifesteal per tick
records the running bullet (CupheadTarget.CurrentHit) so an enemy hit also gets the bullet's slow, knockback and ModdingUtils gravity
clears the running bullet even if RPCA_DoHit throws (a nested hit gets the outer bullet back)
one hit per bullet per Cuphead enemy group per holdPlayerFor (ROUNDS's playersHit for enemies): drilling or piercing bullets cannot hit every frame
a bouncing bullet ends at a Cuphead enemy as it does at a ROUNDS player (no bouncing off bosses, no Trickster gain from the boss)
a drilling bullet ends at a Cuphead enemy as at a player instead of drilling through it like a wall (later effects such as poison still run)
bullet size and Ghost Bullets' ignoreWallsMask include enemy hit areas (layer 15); floors and walls stay out of ignoreWallsMask
starts this blast's bookkeeping so each Cuphead enemy group takes the blast once, through its closest visible hit area
restores the previous blast context when Explode returns or throws

every Explosion card on Cuphead enemies: slow, silence, Overpower (15% of the blocker's max HP), HitArea damage with dmgColor, Implosion pull, force with flyingFor and stun, using ROUNDS's scale flags, line of sight and immunity, once per enemy per blast; co-op: a partner's blast only heals you
skipped on an object with no ParticleSystem (Healing field's circle: plain ROUNDS throws there)

the gun's masked sprites (Handle, Barrel) come on in gun black (tuning gunShade) with their masks off, after ROUNDS colours a gun: ROUNDS shows its gun as a soft shadow (SFPolygon), which our frame has no shadow pass for
safety net: no Overpower call with a null CharacterData or a missing spawner (the NRE that aborted the whole blast)
Dazzle stuns the Cuphead enemy it is attached to (no NRE); on a wall it does nothing
one Dazzle per Cuphead enemy (or per map piece) instead of one for the whole shared sandbox map
FollowPlayer{target=Other} (Chilling Presence and Lifestealer victim particles) sits on the enemy the aura chose, else the closest enemy, else is parked; no per-frame NRE and never on the partner
co-op: the partner no longer counts as an enemy for cone cards, so Glare does not slow them and Low Ground does not switch on from them
a Cuphead enemy inside the cone meets the condition (range, angle and sight measured to its centre or nearest point), so Low Ground's buffs switch on with an enemy above you
PCE Glare slows every Cuphead enemy in sight by 1 - 0.85^(glare x Glare cones), renewed every frame while it stays in sight
King Midas gilds the Cuphead enemies you touch (within 1.75 of their hit area): StGold kept, one FxGold 0.5 slow; it never gilds the partner
Discombobulate's block action also confuses Cuphead enemies (confuse = silence + StConfused) that are within discombobulateRange of the block and in sight, for discombobulateDuration
co-op: Discombobulate never reverses the partner's controls

Murder does nothing in the arena: no RPCA_Die on the partner 2 s after the pick and no ModdingUtils murder stack; Cuphead keeps the stacks in the Roundhead save (one per Murder pick) and spends them at the next level
the BattleStart murder hook does nothing in the arena (it would kill the partner); Cuphead spends Murder itself
opens a per-tick set of Cuphead enemy groups (CupheadTarget.OncePerGroup): one laser damage tick hits each enemy once, not once per mirrored hit area
closes the tick's group set (restores an outer one), also when HurtBox throws
the PCE laser beam passes through Cuphead enemies as it does through ROUNDS players, bounces off Cuphead floors and walls, ends at the level bounds, and bounces at most 16 times (not 1000)
PCE's own switchWeapon laser toggle (it reads the hidden window) is skipped for arena players; Cuphead's switch presses (Slot2 U_SwitchPresses) toggle the laser instead, in ArenaModTicker
Super Jump charges from Cuphead's down key (Slot2 U_DownHeld, or the fed move direction) instead of InControl playerActions.Down

Demonic Possession's nuke, rain and wall bullets start over the top of Cuphead's view instead of at world (0,100), just under a Cuphead ceiling when there is one; under a ceiling the nuke is dropped down instead of fired up
Thank You Sir, May I Have Another?: each Cuphead hit that lands (Arena.CupheadHit) adds the card's max and current ammo, as a ROUNDS bullet hit would (applied only when PCE is installed)

per-enemy coroutine time: a wait started by a slowed or stunned enemy runs at Delta x its ROUNDS speed (0 while frozen, 1 - slow while slowed), speeds back up when the status ends, and stops at a hard cap of maxWaitStretch x time + maxWaitExtra; Cuphead's hit-pause (DamageReceiver), HitFlash and Level waits are untouched; costs one counter increment while no enemy shows a status
the same per-enemy coroutine time for the overload that takes a CupheadTime.Layer

silence/confuse: a projectile that appears inside (or within silenceSpawnPad of) a silenced enemy's hit area becomes a harmless faded dud: its DamageDealer stops damaging players, it keeps its colliders and is never destroyed, so scripts that wait for it to land keep working; parryable (pink) projectiles stay live; a projectile already made a dud at ObjectPool.Spawn gets the DamageDealer built by Start muted at once, and a dud undoes itself when the projectile is recycled or disabled (its Player flag and sprite colours come back), so every life is decided afresh

silence/confuse for pooled projectiles: ObjectPool re-activates them with SetActive(true) and never runs Start again, so every activation re-runs the dud test; a parryable one is let go at its first LateUpdate (its spawner sets CanParry after Spawn returns)

Dev only (ROUNDHEAD_DEV=statuses in a Melty test run). Counts the boss's waits that reach CupheadTime.WaitForSeconds, both overloads. This is the inlining check for the per-enemy wait dilation. It is patched only when the status bench starts.

Dev only (ROUNDHEAD_DEV=statuses). EndFrame drops statuses the ROUNDS table did not refresh, so this re-merges the statuses the Cuphead-side bench is holding right after it. That way the bench's slow and stun survive ArenaClient.ReadStatus in the same frame. It is patched only when the bench starts.
Bouncy, Riccochet, Mayhem, Trickster, Target Bounce and Super Ball bullets bounce at the Cuphead view's edges (ArenaViewCam), not at ROUNDS's menu camera 1000 units above the arena
Looper wraps bullets at the Cuphead view's edges
ROUNDS's fixed screen box becomes the Cuphead level view, just inside the level walls, so PCE Pac-Bullets and Pac-Player wrap there
PCE Fireworks pop near the top of the Cuphead view (handed ArenaViewCam instead of MainCam)
Homing bullets curve toward the closest visible Cuphead enemy, never toward the shooter or the partner
Target Bounce re-aims at the closest visible Cuphead enemy after a bounce (0.1 s pause, aim line)
Radar Shot auto-fires attack-level shots at the closest visible Cuphead enemy in range, never at the partner
Chase's +60% speed turns on when moving toward a visible Cuphead enemy, not toward the partner
Saw's owner from the nearest SpawnedAttack, else the player it sits on (Abyssal Countdown's saw: an NRE in plain ROUNDS)
Saw and Abyssal Countdown saw the closest visible Cuphead enemy (continuous damage plus both pushes); the partner is never shoved
Radiance rings hit and push the closest visible Cuphead enemy once per ring, never the partner
Chilling Presence and Lifestealer auras fire on the closest visible Cuphead enemy in range (ROUNDS: nobody solo, the partner in co-op)
Chilling Presence's additive slow lands on the aura's enemy
Lifestealer's drain hits the aura's enemy (the owner's heal stays native); Demonic Pact's self-cost is untouched
Shield Charge bumps each Cuphead enemy once per charge: damage, knockback, recoil and the automatic block
co-op: charging into the partner no longer knocks them back
a thruster stuck to a light Cuphead enemy lasts the full player time (bosses keep ROUNDS's x0.2)
a thruster pushes the Cuphead enemy it sticks to on every physics step (continuous force)
Remote bullets steer toward the Cuphead cursor, or the Cuphead aim, instead of the hidden ROUNDS window's mouse
remember where a Teleport starts
Teleport never lands outside the level (past Cuphead's bound walls or ceiling); ROUNDS's 10 steps are re-run inside the level view
